Recovery via Allocate Substitute is feasible using verified on-hand substitute MAT-ALLOY-B to cover the 70 units required across two jobs. It completes in 35 hours at $3,115 total ($2,975 labor + $140 material premium), meeting the 36-hour and 48-hour due windows using CELL-MILL-1. Counterfactual: Wait for Replenishment is feasible but completes in 83 hours (48-hour lead time + 35-hour production) missing both due dates despite $0 incremental cost and held lot remaining unavailable. Split Capacity is also feasible and fastest at 17.5 hours by splitting across CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2, but costs $3,202.50 ($87.50 more than Allocate Substitute) for the same material premium. Business assumptions: quantities use current certificate, receiving and stock records; cell costs use current hourly rates; substitute allocation uses only verified available stock. Constraints preserved: held lot remains on hold, no supplier messaging, and costs reflect labor plus material premium.
